messages:
Anna (prod): Quick sync — planning regional feature-slices for routing rollout. Need alignment on fallback ordering, canary windows, and A/B measurement. Proposal: deterministic local fallback -> cross-region failover -> model-variant downgrade. Thoughts?
Mike S: +1. Can we list non-negotiables from customers (SLA, data residency)? that constrains cross-region failover.
Jess R: Agree. Also we should codify launch gates: (1) p99 latency delta < 250ms, (2) error rate delta < 0.5% absolute, (3) quality regression < 1% on eval prompts. If any fail, immediate rollback to previous flag.
Luis G: Sketch of the flag rule I had in mind:
```json
{
  "feature_slice": "eu-west-1",
  "traffic_pct": 10,
  "fallback_order": ["same-region-fallthrough", "cross-region-eu->us", "model-downgrade-quantized"],
  "canary_window_minutes": 60
}
```
Sophia L: For A/B windows: start with 1% for 30m, then 5% for 2h, then 20% for 6h. During each step we run synthetic probe set + top customer traffic checks. Add a health-check that runs per-minute.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated in eu-west-1 (canary id: c-2026-11). Logs: `service.router: canary-started` :rocket:
Mike S: Important: enterprise customers with pinned regions must never cross-region failover unless explicitly allowed. We should have a policy flag `allow_cross_region_failover` per-org.
Anna (prod): Good call. Default behavior: cross-region only for public tenants; private/enterprise => stay in-region and do model downgrade. Document this in rollout runbook.
Jess R: Rollback triggers: sustained error rate > 0.5% for 5m, p99 latency regression > 300ms for 3 consecutive windows, or quality drop > 1.5% on QA set. Also add manual rollback button in Console.
Luis G: Note on model downgrade: fallback to quantized variant will shave 40-60ms but may change tokenization/outputs. Need an automated eval suite to check top-5 prompt outputs for semantic drift before permitting downgrade.
Sophia L: Also add circuit-breaker at edge for request spikes: if inbound qps > baseline*3 for 2m, flip feature flag to 0%. That avoids overload during partial failures.
Anna (prod): Next steps: 1) Mike to draft per-org failover policy, 2) Jess to author gate thresholds + runbook steps, 3) Luis to add flag schema + sample configs, 4) Sophia to wire probes/dashboards, 5) @eng-oncall to add alert rules. I'll create a rollout doc and link here for review: <https://redwood.internal/docs/rollouts/regional-fallbacks> :memo: 
Mike S: I'll have the policy PR by EOD tomorrow.
eng-oncall: Added placeholder alerts: `router.canary.error_rate`, `router.canary.p99_latency`, `router.canary.quality_delta`.
Anna (prod): Awesome. If no major objections we start drafting canary tasks and QA checklist. :thumbsup:
